scenario.name: Two separate power-ups
scenario.heading: N
scenario.expected: The start cell has dust: Clean is Power Up for ticks 1-5, then Start for ticks 6-7. At tick 8 it is on the second dust cell (4,2): Clean is Power Up for ticks 8-9. At tick 10 the top wall is in front and it stops with Clean Stop, 3 power-up ticks left. After the stop and the right turn it goes forward with Clean Power Up for ticks 20-22 and Clean Start from tick 23.
